title: Geometric reading of $G/3$ as the Borromean volume over $|S_4|$
html:
Remark. Geometric reading of G/3 as the Borromean volume over |S_4|

Remark (geometric interpretation of G/3). The blending parameter approximates G/3. This fraction carries a geometric meaning:

  \frac{G}{3} \;=\; \frac{\mathrm{Vol}(B_3)}{24} \;=\; \frac{\mathrm{Vol}(B_3)}{|S_4|}.

It evaluates the hyperbolic volume of the Borromean link averaged over the complete symmetric group of four nucleons.
